title: Vegan Kenyan Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Kenyan-inspired stir fry made with wilted vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Wilted vegetables (such as spinach, kale, and collard greens)

instructions: Heat the avocado oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sweet potato and carrots and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the bell peppers and cook for an additional 3-4 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the wilted vegetables and cook until they are heated through, about 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Squeeze the lime juice over the top and stir to combine.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
